pages.text: Divining Rods scan the ground ahead of you and report the EMC value of what is buried there. They are a prospecting tool: use one to decide where to dig.$(br2)$(l)How to get them:$() each rod is a frame of the matching Covalence Dust with the previous rod in the centre.$(br2)$(li)Low Rod: Low Covalence Dust + a wooden stick.$(li)Medium Rod: Medium Covalence Dust + Low Rod.$(li)High Rod: High Covalence Dust + Medium Rod.
$(l)Using them:$() right-click a block face to scan a deep box in front of you. You get a chat readout of the $(l)average$() and $(l)highest$() EMC in the area.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()

$(li)Each rod has a maximum range mode: the Low Rod scans 3 blocks deep, the Medium 16, and the High 64.$(li)The Medium and High rods also report the second-highest value, and the High rod the third-highest, helping you pick the best spot.$(li)Blocks without an EMC value are valued through their smelting result, so ores read correctly.$(li)The rods work on any block, not just ores, so they are a general "is this area worth digging" tool.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific.
